title: Copykind
summary: Copykind is a powerful spell that allows the Seeker to borrow the special abilities of allied Titans. It is the strongest power of Master Storm.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale learned the Copykind spell from Master Storm in China and, after using it to borrow the power of teleportation from Umbra, used the spell in the Castle of Vlad Dracul to gain Ignatius' ability to control fire and defeat Tantras and Powerbonded Antedeluvian. [Lok's Leadership]

Dante Vale used Copykind whilst fighting Rassimov to replicate his Stormflare spell, blasting him at point-blank range. He was later forced to use the spell on Maelstrom in order to absorb the Red Comet and stopping it from hitting earth, albeit sacrificing himself. [The Spiral Mark]

Upon his resurrection, Dante revealed he had used Copykind on Phoenix at the last second, copying its rebirth ability and returning for a final showdown against the Betrayer. [The Spiral Mark]
